# Contract: schedule.json

**Generated by:** `scripts/convert_schedule.py` (from `schedules/<station>.yaml`)
**Consumed by:** MicroPython `main.py` (uploaded to the device as `schedule.json`); future Rust `build.rs`
**Source of truth:** the YAML — never hand-edit the JSON.

---

## Shape

```json
{
  "station": "mystation",
  "weekday": {
    "a": [302, 314, 327],
    "b": [325, 333, 341]
  },
  "weekend": {
    "a": [337, 349, 360],
    "b": [302, 314, 328]
  }
}
```

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `station` | str | Display name; from the YAML `station:` field, or the filename stem |
| `weekday` / `weekend` | object | Either may be omitted if that period has no service |
| direction keys (`a`, `b`, …) | array of int | **Free-form labels** — name them per station. `main.py` iterates whatever keys are present, so `a`/`b` or `meguro`/`shibuya` both work |
| array values | int | **Minutes since midnight**, strictly ascending |

> Note: the [concept note](../concept.md) sketches direction keys as
> `direction_a` / `direction_b`. The keys are arbitrary — the V1 files use the
> shorter `a` / `b`. Pick whatever reads well; the firmware doesn't care.

---

## Minutes-since-midnight & post-midnight trains

Values are minutes since 00:00 local (JST). Post-midnight departures use
**extended hours**, matching Japanese timetable convention:

| YAML | Minutes | Wall clock |
|---|---|---|
| `"07:06"` | 426 | 07:06 |
| `"24:03"` | 1443 | 00:03 (next day) |
| `"25:10"` | 1510 | 01:10 (next day) |

Extended hours keep every array sorted ascending, so the firmware logic stays
trivial: *find the first entry greater than the current minute-of-day.*

---

## Invariants (enforced by `convert_schedule.py`)

- Times within a direction are **strictly ascending** — the script aborts otherwise.
- Hours `0–29`, minutes `0–59`.
- Direction keys are copied verbatim from the YAML.

---

## V1 → V2

| V1 (MicroPython) | V2 (Rust/Embassy) |
|---|---|
| `json.load(open("schedule.json"))` at boot | `build.rs` parses this JSON at **compile time** → `const` arrays |
| `schedule["weekday"]["a"]` | `const WEEKDAY_A: &[u16] = &[...]` |

Full pipeline: edit YAML → `make schedule` → `schedules/<station>.json` →
`make upload` (lands on the device as `schedule.json`).
